narrative.overview:
Hello Duang is a home listening library that reads as a course and plays as a lesson. The room is a morning window: cool mist for the ground, a warm sun washing the upper left, a cool sky washing the upper right, and a pale cool pool sitting low and toward the center. Panels are large, quiet, and slightly lifted. Sapphire is the only accent, reserved for the action, the current place, and the sound that is playing. The page is light only, open rather than dense, and the phone width is the first layout.

Glass is the material. Panels and the top bar each ship a nearly opaque fill, then, where backdrop-filter exists, a blur and a saturate over a more transparent white. Support is probed at a 12px blur; the paints that actually run are a 22px blur at 1.7 saturation on panels and a 20px blur at 1.6 saturation on the bar. Depth stays soft: a contact shadow, a wide lift with negative spread, and a white inset along the top of a panel.

Chinese and English share one system sans stack, so both scripts stay the faces the device already has. The wordmark is that stack at body size, semibold, tracked tight. There is no mascot and no second display face. A lesson announces itself with a light-weight mark; a word without a family pixel keeps the picture frame and shows a light sapphire letter. The pixel files are household pictures, rendered crisp, and they sit outside the type system.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mist ground with a warm sun, a cool sky, and a lower pale pool
Frosted panels with a 28px radius, a hairline, a soft offset shadow, and a solid fallback
One sapphire accent for the action, the current place, and the card that is playing
One system sans stack for both scripts, with light-weight letters beside the family pixels
A phone-width column first, a 48px primary action, and 44px play controls
Lifts and the playing bars only when the system allows motion

rules.name: The One Sapphire Rule
rules.body: Sapphire is the only accent. It colors the listening word in the headline, the primary action, the current navigation item, the current letter, unit titles, tags, the slow-speed key, links, and the ring on the card that is playing. The sun, sky, and lower pool are light on the ground, not accents.

rules.name: The Solid Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every blurred surface declares a nearly opaque fill in the base rule. The blur, the saturation, and the more transparent fill apply only inside support for backdrop-filter. A panel still has to read when the filter is missing.

rules.name: The One Stack Rule
rules.body: Chinese and English share the system sans stack. Do not add a display face, a serif, or a monospace wordmark. The phonetic face is only for IPA.

rules.name: The Light Letter Rule
rules.body: Oversized letters stay in the system stack at weight 300. A lesson mark is ink. The letter that stands in for a missing pixel is sapphire, inside the picture frame. Pixel files are not type.

rules.name: The Column Rule
rules.body: Content sits in a centered column, min(1120px, 100% − 32px). The first screen is one band: headline, primary action, then a full-width glass instrument. Two columns start at 700px for the continue instrument and the subject list, at 800px for lesson cards, and at 960px for a vertical letter rail beside the words.

rules.name: The Soft Offset Rule
rules.body: Resting glass uses one stacked shadow: a 1px contact shadow and a wide lift with negative spread, plus a white inset hairline on panels. The primary button carries a shorter sapphire lift. The playing card replaces the resting shadow with a 2px sapphire ring.

rules.name: The Panel Radius Rule
rules.body: Listening panels, lesson cards, and word cards share the 28px radius. Subject rows and the desktop letter rail use 22px. Picture frames use 18px, the small pixel thumbs 16px, the primary button 14px, and play keys 12px. Nav hits, tags, the practice control, letter keys, and meters are pills.

rules.name: The Playing Ring Rule
rules.body: The word card that is playing draws a 2px sapphire ring and a sapphire-tinted lift. The active play control hides its triangle and shows three bars in the current text color. A failed card draws a 2px ember ring and shows the retry line in ember.

rules.name: The Picture Frame Rule
rules.body: A family pixel is contained, crisp, and centered on tile white with the picture-frame hairline. A missing pixel keeps the frame, uses a translucent white well, and shows a light sapphire letter. Do not substitute clipart.

dos: **Do** paint the page on window mist and set the warm sun, the cool sky, and the lower pool behind the column.
**Do** declare the solid glass fill and the solid bar fill first, and add blur only where backdrop-filter is supported.
**Do** keep sapphire as the only accent. The primary action is filled sapphire, 48px tall, 14px radius.
**Do** set Chinese and English in the one system stack. Lesson marks and missing-picture letters are weight 300.
**Do** render a family pixel crisp, contained, on tile white. When the file is missing, keep the frame and use the light sapphire letter.
**Do** draw keyboard focus as a 2px sapphire outline, 3px outside the control. When the system asks for less motion, drop transitions, lifts, and the bar animation.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent, a rainbow letter scale, a mascot, or a separate display, serif, or monospace wordmark.
**Don't** let a panel depend on backdrop-filter for its fill.
**Don't** use a hard offset shadow. Resting depth is the soft stacked shadow.
**Don't** treat pixel word pictures as type or as clipart, and don't fill a missing picture with anything other than the light letter in the same frame.
**Don't** shrink the primary action below 48px, or the play and practice controls below 44px. The 36px letter keys belong to the rail only.
